html:
The Accudyne Systems Team will be packing there bags and flying to San Diego, CA to exhibit at the Composites and Advanced Materials Expo (CAMX), September 10-12, 2024. Mike Case, Matt Roesle, and Stephan Zweidler will be available to discuss your composite manufacturing automation challenges and how our custom manufacturing automation solutions can save the day. Come see us in Booth QQ26!

If you’d like to pre-arrange a meeting with us, please visit our Google Calendar!
Please note: The meeting booking schedule will show in your time zone. Rest assured, we’re scheduling meetings from 9:00AM – 12:00PM and 1:00PM – 5:00PM Pacific Daylight Savings Time during the exhibition hall hours.

Stephan will be presenting an Educational Session addressing Advances in and Integration of Stringer Forming Technologies on Wednesday September 11th in the afternoon, so be sure to check that out.

We’re looking forward to seeing you @ CAMX2024!
